department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 10, 2026 for Fall 2027 (same for international applicants); funding requests are considered for Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: International Applicants F (student) or J (exchange visitor) visas; A, E, G, H, I and L visas and immigrants December 10, 2026

gre_subject.value: No subject test exists for this field.

supervisor.value: Fall entrants are funded by the department in the first semester and join a research group in the second semester.
supervisor.quote: If you are admitted and enrolled in the Fall semester, it is an expectation that a first year student will receive financial support from the department during the first semester. | In the second semester of the first year (and future semesters), a student will join a group and receive financial support from a faculty advisor.

funding.value: Qualified PhD students are typically supported on research assistantships; Fall entrants are expected to get first-semester department support; fellowships are competitive.
funding.quote: Graduate research assistantships typically support qualified Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: Open to students with a bachelor's in any engineering or science field.
entry_route.quote: Graduate study is open to qualified students holding a bachelor’s degree from accredited programs in any of the engineering and science areas.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives a few fee waivers for Fall PhD applications, first come first served; contact the department.
fee_waiver.quote: We offer fee waivers on a first come first serve for fall Ph.D applications.
